bio.text: Eric Pratt, a Republican from Prior Lake, has served in the Minnesota Senate since 2013 and has represented District 54 since 2023.
He is the Republican candidate for Minnesota's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, facing Democrat Matt Little in the general election.
He served on the Prior Lake-Savage school board from 2000 to 2012, and his legislative record lists his occupation when first elected as banking risk management at U.S. Bancorp.
He holds a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Colorado and an MBA from the University of St. Thomas.

sources.title: Matt Little wins DFL primary in CD2, will face Eric Pratt in general election
